note: First-load JS per route, uncompressed bytes, from .next/diagnostics/route-bundle-stats.json. Each budget is the route as measured (measured.routes) +2%, rounded up. Re-measured for the Stage redesign: a new design (the 21st.dev components, with the heavy ones below the first screen loading after the page) and a new route set (/works, /works/[slug] and /colophon retired). Every built route has its own line; a route without one (a page added since) gets defaultRouteBudget, which is the largest line after the home page, and gets its own line in the next re-measure. A budget moves only in a commit that says why: a change that goes over reports it in its PR instead of raising its own line. fontsSelfHosted: no built stylesheet may reference fonts.googleapis.com. Checked by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs (npm run budget).
